The '''Revived Heart''' is an {{Epic}} [[Helmet]]. It is unlocked at {{Coll|Zombie Slayer 6}}, is the upgraded form of the {{Item|Crystallized Heart}}, and is the final form of the {{Item|Zombie's Heart}}.
